answer: In an AI-agent marketplace trading onyx, each seller must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before submitting one bid per auction. A tide of fake identities cannot multiply bidding capacity for free: every extra identity ties up another $100 for the full lock period. Accounts cannot reuse the same collateral, so an echo of cloned agents scales the attacker’s capital requirement linearly, though a wealthy attacker can still buy capacity.
